================================================================================
KEY OBSERVATIONS
================================================================================

1. ALL resources share the same msg[0]: [887]...[1040][191][127]_ (22 glyphs)
   This is likely a common chargen intro/prompt message.

2. msg[1] in R1196-R1197 is 25 glyphs, but in R1203+ it's 193 glyphs.
   The 193-glyph msg[1] contains numbered options (1-9+) and is a menu/list.

3. HP/MP appear as literal ASCII in a fixed phrase:
   [259]}[211][268][136]HP{MP[158][670][1241][123][127]!
   This is dialogue text mentioning HP and MP, NOT stat labels.

4. ON/OFF appear in R1203-R1212 (not R1196-R1202) as toggle options:
   [234][254]}[156]ON/OFF[133][123][127]_
   These are likely in-game toggle confirmations.

5. Gold amounts (1000G, 2000G, 5000G, etc.) appear in shop/purchase contexts.

6. B2-B10 references appear in R1204-R1212 respectively:
   [273][268][239]}[466][377]...[298][277][64257][65505]B##[65504][64256]
   These are floor/basement references for dungeon exploration.

7. 0123456789- appears as a number rendering template (11 glyphs).
   Used for stat/number display formatting.

8. These resources are NOT chargen state resources for character creation.
   They contain NPC dialogue, shop interactions, dungeon exploration text,
   and event scripts. The 'chargen state' hypothesis was incorrect.

9. The stat labels for character creation are likely in EXE structs or
   rendered via R1272 font tile mappings, not in these MSG resources.
